name: Hamidur Rahman
role: Designer of the Central Shaheed Minar
contribution: Hamidur Rahman designed the Central Shaheed Minar complex, giving the memory of the 1952 language martyrs a lasting architectural form.
context: His design belongs to the later 1950s and 1960s, when the Language Movement was being memorialized through public architecture, ritual, and annual commemoration.
impact: Rahman's work transformed martyr memory into a permanent public space where mourning, cultural identity, and political expression could meet.
highlight: Designer of Bangladesh's Central Shaheed Minar memorial complex.
seoTitle: Hamidur Rahman: Designer of the Central Shaheed Minar
seoDescription: Learn about Hamidur Rahman and the architectural design of Bangladesh's Central Shaheed Minar memorial to the 1952 language martyrs.
shortAnswer: Hamidur Rahman was the artist and architect associated with the design of the Central Shaheed Minar.

faq.question: What did Hamidur Rahman design?
faq.answer: He designed the Central Shaheed Minar complex, the principal public memorial to Bangladesh's 1952 language martyrs.
